Validate Input-Output data with comprehensive exploded report

validate_io_data.Rd

Usage

validate_io_data(
  sector,
  intermediate_consumption,
  final_demand,
  added_value,
  labour,
  land_proportion,
  landuse_table = NULL,
  growth_rate = NULL,
  tolerance_io = 0.01,
  stop_on_fail = TRUE
)

Arguments

sector

A data frame or tibble with at least two columns: sector name and category.

intermediate_consumption

A numeric matrix of intermediate consumption (Sector x Sector).

final_demand

A numeric matrix of final demand (Sector x Final Demand component).

added_value

A numeric matrix of added value (Component x Sector).

labour

A vector, one-column matrix, or one-column data frame/tibble containing labour per sector.

land_proportion

A numeric matrix of land proportion (Sector x Land Cover Class).

landuse_table

Optional data frame or tibble with at least columns "LC" (land cover name) and "area" (hectares). Number of rows must equal the number of columns of `land_proportion`. If `NULL` (default), the land use checks are reported as `SKIP` and not run.

growth_rate

Optional numeric vector of length `n_sec` containing sectoral growth rates (in decimal, e.g., 0.02 for 2 (default), the growth rate checks are reported as `SKIP` and not run.

tolerance_io

Numeric; maximum allowed absolute relative difference for the IO identity. Default 0.01 (1

stop_on_failLogical; if `TRUE` (default), stops on any `FAIL`.

A tibble with validation results (invisibly if all pass). Checks dimensions, sector names, data types, missing values, non‑negativity (for IC and labour only), land proportions, land use table consistency, growth rates, and the fundamental IO identity (warning only). Prints a detailed validation report; stops only on critical failures.
